name: Garden onion (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Garden onion (Allium cepa) [Vegetables] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DUKE, MANUAL.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 170000 (Onions, raw, SR Legacy)
Rodriguez Galdon, Rodriguez Rodriguez & Diaz Romero 2008, J Agric Food Chem 56(15):6512 doi:10.1021/jf800282h (organic acids in onion cultivars)
Liguori et al. 2017, J Food Quality 2017:6873651 doi:10.1155/2017/6873651 (organic acids, white onion landraces)
Yoo et al. 2015, Int J Food Prop doi:10.1080/10942912.2015.1042589 (validated HPLC pyruvic acid in onion)
Jansen et al. 2024, fructan content Slovenian foods, PMC11327153
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy sources for growth are the free hexoses (glucose 1.97 > fructose 1.29 g/100g) plus a large inulin-type fructan reservoir (~2 g/100g) that hydrolyses to fructose+glucose. Organic acids (malic + citric ~50 mg/100g each, plus pyruvic) were entirely missing from the FooDB profile and were added. Onion is defined by its organosulfur cysteine-sulfoxides (isoalliin), a real S/C source retained qualitatively. Low fat, no B12, low protein; 25 non-nutritive trace/contaminant element
curation_added: citric acid (48.5 mg/100g) - absent from FooDB profile, co-dominant organic acid
malic acid (~55 mg/100g) - co-dominant organic acid
oxalic acid, succinic, fumaric, tartaric, quinic acids
fructans / fructo-oligosaccharides (~2 g/100g) - major fermentable carbon reservoir
quantitative free sugars split (glucose 1.97 > fructose 1.29 > sucrose 0.99 g/100g)

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
